agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review changes neither formal state nor code and does not claim C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.

disagreements.finding: New exact-current finding: aggregate_experience_events consumes event identity with seen.add(event_id) before the record has proven an accepted canonical evidence/verifier binding. An unverified, zero-credit, unknown or otherwise non-accepted first claim can therefore reserve an event_id and cause a later legitimate claim with the same canonical identity to be treated as duplicate. This is denial-of-evidence/first-claim poisoning, distinct from same-evidence/new-ID replay.
disagreements.required_change: Consume/reserve canonical event identity only after event-kind classification and the relevant verified/operational acceptance proof succeeds. Exact same accepted binding replay must NO_OP; same event_id with a different canonical event/evidence/verifier binding must become explicit IDENTITY_CONFLICT; rejected/unverified/ignored claims must not reserve identity.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and installation/runtime identity are unbound.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope with trusted provenance, freshness, scope and policy metadata.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive it from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; lower shift count alone is not success.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from accepted evidence and tested against feedback-loop amplification.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation. Same evidence under new IDs and exact IDs across later calls/restart/rollback/poll can be re-credited; same-ID/different-binding is not durably detected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with immutable binding and exactly-once replay semantics.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt in the executable authority path.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: v2 can deny real Experience outside canonical C_VERIFIED while v2.1 independently recomputes positive verified_experience_delta from raw caller event_kind plus event_independently_verified.
disagreements.required_change: v2.1 must consume immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt or exact inherited eligibility and must not re-mint verified credit from raw caller fields.

disagreements.finding: DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are correctly separated from verified Experience in v2.1, but operational credit is still granted from caller event_id/event_kind without durable artifact/defect acceptance proof.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe; raw caller events may be analytics-only.

disagreements.finding: v1/v2 can output terminal N/R, but select_gear_v2 accepts current_gear only G1..G6, so the controller cannot faithfully round-trip its own prior terminal state into the next cycle.
disagreements.required_change: Use one canonical current-control-state N/R/G1..G6 with explicit trusted terminal-exit authority and consistent v1/v2/v2.1 semantics.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup. Commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency, with frozen metric definitions and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.

statistical_risks: First-claim identity poisoning can suppress later legitimate evidence and makes acceptance/rejection statistics order-dependent.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate or suppress longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Caller-created operational events can inflate durable-progress numerator without proof of durable work.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.

Rejected/unverified/ignored records do not reserve event identity; accepted identities bind exact canonical event/evidence/verifier receipts; exact replay NO_OPs and same-ID/different-binding becomes IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
A durable rollback-resistant event/evidence acceptance registry prevents same-ID replay, same-evidence/new-ID laundering, restart/rollback replay and first-claim identity poisoning.
Secretary routing inputs use replay-resistant provenance/freshness binding and authority_conflict projects an exact trusted authority decision rather than merely neutralizing secretary_level.

recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and stateful enter/exit hysteresis; paired performance shows no safety-upshift or latency regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independently derived and non-self-reinforcing.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence identity and trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt; v2.1 cannot re-mint verified credit from raw caller fields.
Operational progress requires durable artifact/defect acceptance receipt and lineage dedupe; raw event_kind/event_id is insufficient.
A canonical current-control-state round-trips N/R/G1..G6 and terminal-exit authority is explicit, trusted and consistent across v1/v2/v2.1.
5/4/3/1 credit weights remain explicitly heuristic and are never used as direct capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance or promotion truth.

Speedup uses one frozen versioned metric manifest shared by baseline/candidate and a sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover evaluation over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with equal-or-better verification/risk quality.
Dedicated fresh Spirit review and fresh Navigator synthesis have no unresolved material vetoes before any formal A->B->C route is considered.
